# First terms of the extended Cunningham chain generated by 2

The extended Cunningham
chain $e_0, e_1, e_2, \ldots$ generated by $2$ has $e_1 = 5$, $e_2 = 11$ and $e_3 = 23$.

## Sources

- Miller, Peng, Popescu, Siktar, and Wattanawanichkul, *Walking to Infinity Along Some Number Theory Sequences*, INTEGERS 24 (2024), Article A78, Definition 2.4.
